waitlist screen

Web·by @nachidesigner·2026-08-21·inspora page·original post

What it is

Waitlist screen: saturated blue canvas ('freedrw') with the headline 'Design like it's already coded' where the word 'it's' sits in an italic serif inside a live selection box with a text cursor - as if someone just selected it in a design tool; email input + white 'Join Waitlist' pill, '1,288 people already joined' microcopy, and a giant blurred countdown (03:10:35) anchored to the bottom edge.

Build prompt

Build a waitlist hero on saturated blue (#1683F8). Nav: small wordmark left, About/FAQs right (13px white/80). Center: 3 traffic-light dots (red/amber/green) above a 64px tight-tracked white headline 'Design like it's already coded' - the word 'it's' breaks into italic serif and wears a design-tool selection: 1.5px white dashed rect (4px dash) hugging it with a blinking 2px caret after it (steps(2) 1s). Below: inline pill form - 320px translucent white/15 input ('Enter your email address') with an inset white 'Join Waitlist' button and a small cursor-arrow charm hanging off it; under, 12px white/60 '1,288 people already joined'. Bottom edge: a giant countdown '03:10:35' at ~160px, white/35, blurred 6px like bokeh, half-cropped by the viewport, with tiny 'days/hours/min' labels above each group; digits tick in tabular numerals. Card-in-frame look: the blue field is itself a 24px-radius panel floating on light grey.
